uzo.purpose: Leads between the main pages of an application and shows where the person is; a vertical one groups its items in sections under a heading (h2–h6), an item may show an icon (slot icon-start).

instead.kialo: One link is a ligilo, because a navigation is a list of places with one marked as the current; a single destination has no list and no current.
Views of the same thing on one page are tabs, because the person stays where they are; a navigation leaves the page.
The steps of a process are no menu, because their order is the process and a person may not skip ahead; Fundamento has no step indicator yet, a person decides.

boundary.kialo: A second level that opens under an item is a menu with its own keyboard, because the person moves in two directions; a person decides whether a second navigation on the page does it.

A collapsed navigation needs an overlay with a keyboard of its own (open, close, trap the focus), because the items are hidden until asked for; a navigation that wraps stays visible and needs none of it.
A breadcrumb shows the path to the page, not the pages beside it, because its items are the ancestors in order; that is the spuro (Spec 015 ① closes the boundary breadcrumb).

A panel that slides in from the edge is neither a dialog nor a popover, because it is a region of the page with its own flow (a Sxablono), not a question and not a layer beside a trigger; a person decides until the Sxablonoj come.

containers.name: shell
containers.kialo: A navigation stands in the shell of the application — the region nav of the sxelo — because it belongs to every page and to none.

with.kialo: Its items are links, because each one moves to a page and none acts here.
A count next to an item is an insigno with intent info and a description, because the digit alone says nothing (1 Version in Prüfung).

case.de: Es gibt nur ein einziges Ziel.
Die Person wechselt zwischen Ansichten derselben Seite.
case.en: The person switches between views of the same page.

case.de: Gezeigt werden soll der Weg von oben zur aktuellen Seite.
case.en: The path from the top to the current page is to be shown.

case.de: Die Navigation soll als Rahmen um jede Seite der Anwendung stehen.
case.en: The navigation is to stand as the frame around every page of the application.

do.de: Markiere mit page die Seite, auf der die Person gerade ist.
do.en: Mark with page the page the person is on.

do.de: Gib jeder Navigation mit label einen Namen, sobald eine Seite zwei hat.
do.en: Give every navigation a name with label as soon as a page has two.

do.de: Gruppiere eine senkrechte Navigation in Abschnitte mit Überschrift.
do.en: Group a vertical navigation into sections with a heading.

dont.de: Eine zweite Ebene unter einem Eintrag aufklappen lassen.
dont.en: Let a second level open under an entry.

dont.de: Die Einträge auf schmalen Bildschirmen hinter einem Menüknopf verstecken; die Navigation bricht stattdessen um.
dont.en: Hide the entries behind a menu button on narrow screens; the navigation wraps instead.

none.de: Die Navigation nimmt keine eigene Taste; ihre Einträge sind Verweise, die man mit Tab erreicht und mit Enter öffnet.
none.en: The navigation takes no key of its own; its entries are links reached with Tab and opened with Enter.
